description: This file defines configuration data and helper functions for callback integrations in a dashboard UI, including callback configurations, mappings between display names and internal IDs, and utility functions to retrieve callback configurations.

classes.name: CallbackConfig
classes.description: Interface representing the configuration for a callback integration, including ID, display name, logo, support for team logging, dynamic parameters, and description.

methods.name: mapDisplayToInternalNames
methods.description: Maps an array of display names to their corresponding internal callback IDs using callback_map.

methods.name: mapInternalToDisplayNames
methods.description: Maps an array of internal callback IDs to their display names using reverse_callback_map.

methods.name: getCallbackById
methods.description: Retrieves a callback configuration object by its internal ID.

methods.name: getCallbackByDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves a callback configuration object by its display name.
